prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: A beautiful Spanish-language explanatory 3D infographic for the ADV-050 scientific audit, to show immediately to a curious adult and later accompany a video. Generate a NEW image, landscape 16:9, high resolution, with three generously spaced scientific panels. This is an AI-generated conceptual illustration, NOT numerical evidence, NOT an actual Blender render or a screenshot of the simulations. Put this distinction clearly in the image.

Primary request: Explain visually three genuinely different phenomena beyond water: diffusion of heat, advection (transport), and waves. Use polished dimensional scientific dioramas, physically clear arrows, sophisticated lighting, deep navy background with mint/white typography, copper, blue and amber accents. Readable Spanish text, big graphics, minimal copy, clean editorial composition. Show BEFORE and AFTER states or a short sequence in each panel so the behavior is understandable without narration. No people, no logos, no magical particles, no invented measurement plots.

Scientific context supplied for accuracy, not all to be printed: We tested deterministic 1D periodic equations on domain [0,2*pi), using centered second-order finite differences, RK4 and analytic exact solutions, N=32,64,128, T=0.7, float64. Heat: u_t=kappa*u_xx, kappa=0.13, u0=1+0.5*sin(x)+0.2*cos(2*x), exact solution damps each Fourier mode, preserves spatial average. Advection: u_t=-c*u_x, c=1.3, u0=0.2+sin(x)+0.25*cos(2*x), exact solution translates without changing shape or amplitude. Wave: u_tt=c*c*u_xx, c=0.8, u0=sin(x)+0.25*cos(2*x), initial velocity=0.3*cos(x), oscillatory propagation with conserved total discrete energy approximately. These are dimensionless mathematical models, not measurements in Celsius or meters. The circular geometry is a visual analogy for periodic boundary conditions, not a new 3D PDE. We executed the same source on WAR (5070 host) and GUERRA (4060 host); calculations used CPU, not GPU. Per host there were 3 passing baselines and 18 mutants: 13 detected, 2 survived, 3 algebraically equivalent. These are the same 18 mutants repeated, NOT 36 independent mathematical results. Numerical tests do not establish Euler/Navier-Stokes singularity. The prior fluid movie showed vorticity, not an actual water surface. Do not say the Millennium problem is solved.

Composition:
Main heading exactly: "NO TODO ES AGUA"
Subheading exactly: "Tres fenómenos. Tres formas de comprobarlos."

Panel 1 title: "1 · CALOR"
Two matching copper rings, same orientation, BEFORE has distinct hot red and cool blue sectors; AFTER has smoother reduced color contrast, more uniform temperature while maintaining the average, no directional rotation. A small simple arrow indicating evolution in time. Do not make heat grow or develop new sharp peaks. Caption exactly: "Las diferencias se suavizan."
Small secondary label: "Difusión"

Panel 2 title: "2 · TRANSPORTE"
Two or three matching transparent periodic rings with a colored profile or bright pulse shifted clockwise between states, visibly SAME shape, width and height. A single clockwise motion arrow. Do not broaden or fade it. Caption exactly: "El perfil viaja sin deformarse."
Small secondary label: "Advección"

Panel 3 title: "3 · ONDAS"
A flexible closed string shown in perspective in two successive oscillatory shapes, with marked material points and short vertical arrows showing local up-down oscillation; distinguish the propagation arrow from the oscillation arrows. No bulk flow, no water splash. Caption exactly: "El medio oscila; la perturbación se propaga."
Small secondary label: "Ondas"

Below the three panels, a restrained evidence strip with exact text: "Pruebas por máquina: 3 referencias válidas · 13 mutantes detectados · 2 no detectados · 3 equivalentes"
Footer prominently and legibly: "Ilustración didáctica generada con IA. No es un resultado de simulación."
Second short footer: "Las pruebas numéricas no sustituyen una demostración matemática."

Constraints: Scientific distinctions must be correct. Render quoted Spanish text accurately with accents. No fake numeric axes or fabricated experimental data. Do not imply the illustrated rings are the actual test apparatus. Prioritize visible explanations and readable labels over extra decoration.
